name: 22936 · Earlysville, VA
findings: ZIP 22936 (Earlysville) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22936 (Earlysville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 5 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
